## Highlights since 0.19.4

- **Lattice on the Mac is now the native app.** From this update, every Mac runs the native Lattice, drawn by the Mac's graphics hardware instead of a web page, on Apple silicon and on Intel Macs alike. It looks and works the way Lattice does, and it is faster and lighter. Updating installs it in place of the classic version, with nothing to choose. Your recent projects, settings, themes, plugins, project templates, Agent skills, Agent conversations and Overleaf links come with you. If you had switched back to the classic version, what you changed there since comes along too: the projects you opened, the settings you changed, and the themes, plugins, templates and skills you added. Typst support downloads again the first time you build a Typst document. The native version has no grammar check and no dictionaries for other languages; spell check uses macOS's own checker. Windows and Linux keep the classic version.
- **No more switching back.** Settings › Editor & builds no longer offers to switch back to the classic version. The classic version's data stays on your Mac, untouched.
